common.tagline: Learn languages through contextual translation, SRS and AI feedback.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.description: Sign in to continue your learning path.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: Free. Just an email and a password.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish signing up.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If the email exists, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Your new password must be at least 8 characters.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Email not confirmed yet. Open the link in your inbox.
errors.weakPassword: Password is too weak. Choose a longer one.
errors.samePassword: The new password must differ from the old one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.linkInvalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Please try again.
errors.sessionMissing: Your reset session expired. Request a new link.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordMax: Password must be at most 72 characters.
validation.level_mismatch: Level does not match the language.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: What shall we learn today?
dashboard.streakBest: Best: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
dashboard.reviewDue: {count, plural, one {# card is waiting} other {# cards are waiting}}

language.title: Which language do you want to learn?
language.description: You can change this later in Settings.

level.title: What is your current level?
level.description: Lessons and AI grading adapt to this level.

display.title: Display language
display.description: Language of the interface and AI feedback.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.description: Paste a passage, translate it sentence by sentence and get AI feedback.
lessons.newDescription: Paste the passage you want to practise. It is split into sentences automatically.
lessons.emptyHint: Start with a short passage of 3–5 sentences.
lessons.deleteDescription: "{title}" and all of its attempts will be permanently deleted.

form.title: Title
form.textHint: Each sentence becomes one translation step. A line break also ends a sentence.

textPlaceholder.ja: 昨日、駅の近くのスーパーに行きました。野菜がとても安かったです。
textPlaceholder.en: Yesterday I went to the supermarket near the station. The vegetables were very cheap.

form.titleTooLong: Title must be at most 120 characters.
form.textTooLong: Passage must be at most 5000 characters.
form.tooManySentences: Passage must be at most 200 sentences.

preview.title: {count, plural, =0 {Preview} one {Preview · # sentence} other {Preview · # sentences}}
preview.empty: Sentences appear here once you paste a passage.
preview.tooMany: Only the first {max} sentences can be used. Please shorten the passage.

translate.placeholder: Type the translation of the highlighted sentence...
translate.keyboardHint: Enter to check · Shift+Enter for a new line
translate.allDoneDescription: Claim your reward and see the summary.

errors.rateLimited: You have used today's AI checks. Come back tomorrow.
errors.unavailable: The AI is busy and could not grade this. It was not counted — please try again.
errors.network: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.

result.title: Lesson complete
result.titlePerfect: Perfect! All correct on the first try
result.sentenceSummary: {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} · {points} points

dictionary.saved: Added to your notebook with a flashcard.
dictionary.noEntry: Not in the offline dictionary. Tap "Explain" to ask the AI.

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.description: Words you saved, with the sentence they came from.
notebook.emptyHint: While translating, tap a word and choose "Add to notebook".
notebook.search: Search by word, reading or meaning
notebook.noMeaning: No meaning yet — tap the pencil to add one.
notebook.alreadySaved: This word is already in your notebook.
notebook.deleteDescription: "{term}" and its flashcard will be deleted.
notebook.editDescription: Write the meaning in the way you remember best.

review.remaining: {count, plural, one {# card left} other {# cards left}}
review.tapToFlip: Tap the card or press Space to flip
review.rateLabel: How well did you remember it?
review.doneDescription: {count, plural, one {You reviewed # card.} other {You reviewed # cards.}}
review.nothingDueHint: Translate a new lesson and save words to your notebook.
review.saveFailed: Some reviews could not be saved. Please reload the page.

pomodoro.focusHint: You can leave or reload — the timer runs on server time.
pomodoro.idleHint: Finish a session to plant a tree in your Knowledge Garden.
pomodoro.rewardToast: Session done! +{coins} coins and a new tree.
pomodoro.startFailed: Could not start the session. Please try again.
pomodoro.claimFailed: Could not claim the reward for this session.

garden.title: Knowledge Garden
garden.description: Every completed focus session grows a tree.
garden.emptyHint: Finish a Pomodoro session to plant your first tree.
